decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone, zero tickets, and no customer reply to three Wrenfield emails (email:2e099220, cb1e6271, 13554c68) despite a held kickoff (calendar:bc71f851). Engagement is one-directional, suggesting low unaided momentum in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on more email, so this is my last nudge for now.

The quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for is one real project with your actual tasks -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to sit with you while you set up that first project and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
